symbols.name: ground set size
symbols.meaning: The number of elements of the ground set $[h]$, so $h$ counts elements.
symbols.quote: Let $[h]=\{1,\dots,h\}$ be the ground set, where $h$ is the number of its elements, and let $\mathcal T$ be the set of its three-element subsets.

symbols.name: three-element triples
symbols.meaning: The set of three-element subsets of $[h]$.
symbols.quote: Let $[h]=\{1,\dots,h\}$ be the ground set, where $h$ is the number of its elements, and let $\mathcal T$ be the set of its three-element subsets.

symbols.name: bank X scalar
symbols.meaning: The bank-$X$ scalar stored at the triple $S$.
symbols.quote: Each $S\in\mathcal T$ has a bank-$X$ scalar $x_S$ and a bank-$Y$ scalar $y_S$.

symbols.name: bank Y scalar
symbols.meaning: The bank-$Y$ scalar stored at the triple $S$.
symbols.quote: Each $S\in\mathcal T$ has a bank-$X$ scalar $x_S$ and a bank-$Y$ scalar $y_S$.

relations.quote: The subset-intersection finite network is built as a [linear network](linear-network.md) that exchanges two banks of scalars indexed by three-element subsets of a fixed ground set.
